questions.question_en: Does Assam have a bicameral or unicameral legislature?

questions.answer_en: Bicameral - it has a Legislative Assembly and a Legislative Council.

Unicameral, with only a Legislative Council

options.en: Bicameral, with a Legislative Assembly and a Legislative Council

explanation.en: Assam has a bicameral legislature, with a Legislative Assembly and a Legislative Council.
